description: Controlled Pedestrian Crossings is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. This dataset lists signalised pedestrian crossings and junctions with controlled crossing facilities. Unfortunately, this do not show non-signalised pedestrian crossings, nor audible or tactile paving areas. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are DRD, Pedestrian Crossing, Pelican Crossing, Puffin Crossings, Roads. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
